chapter: Riverboat to New Orleans and Horace Henderson
title: Stranded in Paducah and the telegram from Horace Henderson
summary: After New Orleans the boat band wintered at Paducah with about one job a month, so Jones and Granger took a train home to Louisville, where a telegram from Horace Henderson arrived.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: See, I remembered what happened. Now, these guys are talking. After we played down in New Orleans -- we'd play down there till I think around the 1st of November, and then she heads back up the Mississippi River, and then the band gets off at Paducah, when it gets to Paducah, Kentucky, and then it goes on to Cincinnati and goes in, you know, for the winter.

So now I'm thinking about getting back home, but they keep telling us, no, we'll go to Paducah. We've got a lot of work there. You know, I believe it, and so we get there and we find out we're doing about one job a month, you know. So there's nothing happening. This is the biggest thing these guys have got is that boat every year. But so now they're doing about one job a month. So I'd got to get out of here.
You're hungry. They've got their home.

Yeah, they've got their home there. So me and Granger, we got together -- because every time we'd talk about it they'd try to talk us out of it. And so one time we said, well, we'll get a train and go on back home. So we did, we went back to Louisville. And then I'm there only about a week, and here comes a telegram from Horace Henderson, and Horace has all these guys in the band now. He has -- Russel's in there, trombone, and the trumpet player was -- Spratt, we called him, Bernice Morton, he was a trumpet player, out of the kid band, you know.
